references.text: The burnt offering was to be a bull from the cattle, a male without defect, in accordance with the sacrificial laws in Leviticus
The ram as a burnt offering is mentioned here as an offering from the small livestock, without defect
A one-year-old lamb for a burnt offering is specified, as in Numbers 7:69
A one-year-old lamb for a burnt offering is mentioned in connection with purification rituals
One-year-old lambs are used as daily burnt offerings on the altar
One-year-old lambs without defect as a daily burnt offering, parallel to the offerings from the tribal leaders
Identical sacrificial formula from Nahshon's gift, showing the standardized sacrificial pattern for all the tribal leaders
